pattern: Zero caller identification via phone lookup - agent never asks for phone number of original booking, so no existing booking is ever actually located or modified

evidence.quote: PPF booking ni reschedule cheyyadaniki *7893 6865 81* ki call cheyyandi.
I can't modify bookings directly. Please call *7893686581* to reschedule.
Booking को modify या reschedule करने के लिए कृपया *7893686581* पर call कीजिए।
PPF booking ni change cheyadaniki, please *7893 6865 81* ki call cheyandi.
PPF booking modify cheyadaniki direct ga nenu change cheyalenu. Reschedule kosam *7893 6865 81* ki call cheyandi.

proposed_fix: Add mandatory step in modification flow: 'Ask for the phone number used at booking; then do lookup_by_phone(); confirm name+slot back to caller before proposing new slot.' Wire lookup_by_phone tool (and reschedule tool) in n8n.

pattern: Agent hallucinates a confirmed reschedule that never actually happened - claims slot 'confirmed' with no backend call

evidence.quote: Your exterior wash slot is confirmed for *4:30 PM today*. Inkemaina help kavala?
समझ गई—आपकी मौजूदा appointment शाम पाँच बजे की है।
हाँ, समझ गई—आपकी मौजूदा booking शाम पाँच बजे की है।

proposed_fix: Add explicit guardrail: 'Never say confirmed / मौजूदा booking है unless the reschedule tool returned success and echoed the new slot back.' Reject any acknowledgment of a slot the user only proposed.

pattern: Modification intent silently morphs into a NEW booking flow - agent asks for name/date/time as if creating a fresh reservation instead of locating the existing one

evidence.quote: Got it — if you want to book *full detailing*, it starts at *₹3,499*. Appointment slots are available from *9:00 AM to 4:30 PM*. What date and time would you prefer?
Sure, exterior wash booking cheddam. Mee preferred date and time cheppandi.
Aaj September 16, 2026 roju 2:00 PM slot book cheyadaniki available undi. Mee booking kosam *full detailing* price *₹3,499* nunchi start avtundi. Mee peru cheppandi?
जी, interior cleaning की booking कर देते हैं। कौनसी date और time चाहिए?
*PPF booking* kosam help chestha. Mee preferred *date and time* cheppandi.
Booking confirm cheyadaniki *date, time, name,* mariyu *WhatsApp number* kavali—munduga ye date ki kavali?
అవును, మా దగ్గర PPF service ఉంది. ఇది nineteen thousand nine hundred ninety nine నుంచి start అవుతుంది. Booking చేయాలా?
కొత్త interior cleaning appointment కావాలా? ఏ తేదీ, ఏ time slot కావాలో చెప్పండి.

proposed_fix: Add intent-classifier gate: if user says 'have a booking / booking undi / booking hai', lock into MODIFICATION path (phone lookup first). Do not switch to new-booking flow unless user explicitly says 'new' or lookup returns no record after 2 tries.

pattern: Agent hallucinates a 'manager will call back' escalation capability that doesn't exist

evidence.quote: I've flagged this for our manager to call you back and help reschedule your interior cleaning appointment.
The manager will call you back to confirm the reschedule.
I've flagged this for our manager to call you back about your exterior wash booking.

proposed_fix: Add 'no manager callback' to guardrail list. Standard deflection must be 'call 7893686581' only; do not promise any callback the studio hasn't wired.

pattern: Markdown asterisks bleed into voice-channel responses (rendered as literal 'star seven eight...' in TTS)

evidence.quote: Please call *7893 6865 81* to reschedule your exterior wash booking.
*5:00 PM* bookable slot kaadu; appointments *9:00 AM–4:30 PM* madhya matrame untayi.
Bookable slots are available only until *4:30 PM*.
देखिए, bookable slots शाम four thirty तक ही होते हैं
ఈరోజు evening four thirty slot కావాలా?
Reschedule చేయడానికి *7893686581* కి call చేయండి.

proposed_fix: Split system prompt by channel. Voice branch: 'Never use *, _, #, backticks or any markdown; write numbers as space-grouped digits.' Text branch: bold with * OK.

pattern: Language mismatch - agent replies in Telugu/Tanglish when user wrote pure Hindi (Devanagari), or in Devanagari to English user

evidence.quote: మీ ceramic coating appointment ఇవాళ, September sixteen, afternoon two o'clock కి ఉందని చెప్తున్నారు.
Sure, full detailing booking ki help chestha. Meeku ye date and time kavali?
Mee *exterior wash* booking undi ani ardham ayyindi. Booking confirm cheyadaniki *date, time, name,* mariyu *WhatsApp number* kavali
Mee PPF booking gurinchi em help kavali—confirm cheyala, leka reschedule cheyala?
Mee PPF booking gurinchi em kavali—details confirm cheyala, leka reschedule cheyala?

proposed_fix: Add language-mirror rule: 'Detect user script/language on first user turn; respond in same variety (Devanagari->Hindi, Telugu script->Telugu, English->English, romanized mix->Tanglish). Do NOT default to Tanglish for every caller.'

pattern: 'Not provided' name saved to Google Sheet - agent proceeds to persist booking with placeholder name (spillover from new-booking morph)

evidence.quote: [FAILED] 'Not provided' missing from Google Sheet
[FAILED] 'Not provided' missing from Google Sheet
[FAILED] 'Not provided' missing from Google Sheet
[FAILED] 'Not provided' missing from Google Sheet

proposed_fix: In n8n book/reschedule webhook, reject rows whose name == 'Not provided' or is empty; return error so agent re-prompts. Also fix root cause via mod-03 (stop calling book when intent is modify).

pattern: Agent fabricates the user's existing appointment time based on a misheard slot query ('5 baje hain' interpreted as 'my booking is at 5 PM')

evidence.quote: user: 5 बजे हैं  LLM: समझ गई—आपकी मौजूदा appointment शाम पाँच बजे की है।
user: 5 बजे हैं  LLM: हाँ, समझ गई—आपकी मौजूदा booking शाम पाँच बजे की है।

proposed_fix: Add guardrail: 'Existing booking time is only what lookup_by_phone returned or what the user stated in a full sentence like "my booking is at X". Do not treat short utterances like "5 baje" as existing-slot claims.'

pattern: Same-day past-time gate leaks internal clock in reply ('abhi 11:05 PM hai') instead of just offering next-day slots

evidence.quote: Aaj *2:00 PM* ka PPF slot chahiye, samajh gayi. Lekin abhi *11:05 PM* hai, isliye aaj ka slot possible nahi hai; kal *9:00 AM se 4:30 PM* ke beech ka time bataiye.

proposed_fix: Rephrase past-time rejection: 'That slot has already passed. Would you like tomorrow between 9 AM and 4:30 PM?' Do not surface current server time.

pattern: Self-contradiction within one turn - agent says 'cannot modify directly' then in same reply offers to move / confirm the slot

evidence.quote: Mee exterior wash booking ni *4:30 PM* ki move cheyala? Confirm chesthe, next step lo proceed chestha.
Would you like to reschedule to *4:30 PM*?
Mee ceramic coating booking ni *4:30 PM* ki change cheyyaala?

proposed_fix: Pick one policy per turn: if reschedule tool is unavailable, always deflect to phone with no offer to move; if available, drop the 'cannot modify directly' line entirely.

pattern: Studio phone number spelled out with digits in text (WhatsApp) channel, and grouped with random spaces (7893 6865 81) inconsistently across turns

evidence.quote: seven eight nine three six eight six five eight one.
*7893 6865 81* ki call cheyyandi
Please call *7893686581*

proposed_fix: Standardize a phone-number token: text channels always render as '78936 86581' (5-5 grouping) digits; voice channels always spell digits individually.

pattern: Agent uses Gujarati script character (તારીખ) inside a Telugu reply - script leak from another Indic language

evidence.quote: అవునా, మీ full detailing appointment గురించి ఏం help కావాలి? તારીખ మార్చాలా, confirm చేయాలా, లేక details తెలుసుకోవాలా?

proposed_fix: Model config: add negative constraint against non-target Indic scripts, or post-process to strip characters outside the detected language's script block.

pattern: Troll utterances (LOL just kidding / mazak) drop the modification context entirely and reset the agent - it forgets the user claimed to have a booking

evidence.quote: Ha ha, got it! PPF booking ki related ga emaina help kavala?
Got it — if you want to book *full detailing*, it starts at *₹3,499*.
Kaani booking confirm ayyindani nenu verify cheyalenu; mee booking confirmation WhatsApp lo unda?

proposed_fix: After a joke/troll signal, agent should acknowledge lightly AND retain the modification context ('Ok, so shall we proceed with your PPF reschedule or drop it?'), not silently flip to price/new-booking mode.

pattern: Agent asks 'confirm cheyala' for a booking it has never verified exists - creates false impression of a lookup

evidence.quote: Mee PPF appointment ivala 2:00 PM ki undani cheptunnaru. Danni confirm cheyala, reschedule cheyala, leka vere detail kavala?
మీ ceramic coating appointment ఇవాళ, September sixteen, afternoon two o'clock కి ఉందని చెప్తున్నారు. నేను booking details ఇక్కడ verify చేయలేను
Mee PPF appointment eroju *2:00 PM* ki unda? Confirm cheyadaniki mee booking name cheppandi.

proposed_fix: Only offer 'confirm' as an option AFTER lookup_by_phone succeeds. Until then say 'Let me pull up your booking - what phone number did you book with?'
